key_insight: PathKGen combines whole-slide image features with structured pathology knowledge to generate histopathology reports and expose parts of its reasoning as graphs.
clinical_relevance: This research targets interpretable cancer pathology reporting, not drug discovery, and does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: A visual branch uses pathology foundation models to produce image tokens for a multimodal large language model.
A knowledge branch queries a pathology-specific knowledge graph to produce knowledge tokens.
The model combines both inputs for report generation and visualizes knowledge-based reasoning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports performance exceeding prior state-of-the-art methods on WSI-Bench, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Visible reasoning graphs do not establish diagnostic correctness; clinical validation and knowledge-graph quality remain important concerns.
paper_title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
